title: Repository-Write Chain-Result Artifact Evidence and Byte Verification
primary_claim: Canonical repository-write chain-result bytes can be bound to one exact GateReport-v4 and verified into a mechanical receipt without trusting caller-authored counts, authentication booleans, stage-digest sets, report bindings, or semantically equivalent non-canonical JSON.
acceptance: artifact evidence derives evidence_authenticated from exact retained counts
artifact locator digest equals the declared artifact-content digest
artifact evidence binds the exact GateReport-v4, chain-result, classification and inventory identities
verifier accepts exact immutable bytes only and reconstructs chain-result/1 strictly
duplicate keys, malformed JSON and non-canonical bytes are refused
artifact-content, chain-result, inventory, classification and stage-digest substitutions are refused
all retained counts and authentication state are compared to the reconstructed chain result
an authenticated chain requires an empty repository-write failure set
an unauthenticated or empty chain requires a non-empty repository-write failure set
the receipt provenance binds every report, evidence, byte and logical chain identity
